examples.fr: Le vieux du quartier racontait chaque soir des histoires de sa jeunesse.
examples.en: The old man from the neighbourhood told stories from his youth every evening.

examples.fr: Dans ce village, les vieux se retrouvent chaque après-midi sur la place pour discuter.
examples.en: In this village, the old folks gather every afternoon in the square to chat.

reasons: second example wrongly used 'les vieux' to mean antiques/old things; 'vieux' as a noun means old people
zh '老旧的东西' is not a valid noun sense of 'vieux'
